item.title: Baker Hughes Wins Subsea Contract for Indonesia Gas Hub
item.summary: Baker Hughes, an energy technology company in the U.S., has secured a contract to provide subsea production systems and digital solutions for the Kutei Northern Hub project located offshore Indonesia. This contract was awarded by a subsidiary of Searah, a newly established joint venture formed by Italy’s Eni and Malaysia’s Petronas.
